description: Merge 2 to 20 PDFs into one, in the order given, optionally taking only some pages of each. Costs one PodPDF credit. Docs: https://apidocs.podpdf.com/api-reference/pdf-tools

filename.description: Name for the merged PDF, e.g. "deal-pack.pdf"

files.description: The PDFs to merge, in order

items.description: A PDF: a path on this machine, e.g. "./contract.pdf", or an https:// link to one

pages.description: Optional page range per file, in the same order, e.g. ["", "2-end"]. Blank means every page.

save_path.description: Optional local file path to save the PDF to, e.g. "./invoice.pdf". The download link is returned either way.

name: merge_pdfs
title: Merge PDFs
